source_registry.capture_method: official SBI Group English profile extract

SBI Group voting-rights ownership 82.96% as of 2026-08-28.
SBI Remit describes Ripple DLT remittance activity beginning in 2017 for Japan-Thailand and in 2019 for Japan-Vietnam.
limitations: Profile does not provide customer-level XRP flows or current ODL volumes.

source_registry.publisher: SBI Holdings, SBI Remit and SBI VC Trade
source_registry.capture_method: official SBI Holdings press release extract
claims_supported: SBI Remit, SBI VC Trade and Ripple launched XRP-based international remittance to the Philippines using Ripple ODL.
SBI Remit transmits the customer remittance request; SBI VC Trade supplies XRP liquidity/infrastructure; Coins.ph receives XRP through XRPL and converts to Philippine pesos.
The release describes XRP as a bridge asset intended to reduce pre-funding costs.
limitations: Launch announcement does not establish present-day volume, active corridor throughput or net XRP inventory.

source_registry.publisher: SBI Holdings, SBI VC Trade, Ripple Labs and Standard Custody & Trust Company
source_registry.capture_method: official SBI Holdings press release extract
claims_supported: SBI VC Trade, a consolidated SBI Holdings subsidiary, and Standard Custody & Trust Company, a Ripple subsidiary, signed a basic agreement to issue and distribute RLUSD in Japan.
The release describes RLUSD reserve backing as USD deposits, short-term U.S. Treasuries and cash equivalents, with monthly third-party attestations.
limitations: The August 2025 document is a basic agreement, not evidence of launch on that date.

source_registry.publisher: SBI VC Trade and Ripple Labs
source_registry.capture_method: official SBI Holdings group press release extract
claims_supported: SBI VC Trade began handling RLUSD on its VCTRADE service on 2026-06-24.
The release classifies RLUSD as a Japanese Type 4 electronic payment instrument under SBI VC Trade's stated legal interpretation.
The release identifies SBI VC Trade as an SBI Holdings consolidated subsidiary and the launch as a result of the SBI Group-Ripple partnership.
limitations: The notice establishes product availability, not volume, reserves held by SBI, XRP demand or actual settlement activity.

source_registry.capture_method: official SBI Holdings press release extract
claims_supported: SBI Holdings announced participation alongside Ripple and other investors in Evernorth Holdings' PIPE.
Evernorth was described at the time as an XRP treasury business with a planned business combination and Nasdaq ticker XRPN.
limitations: The announcement does not disclose SBI's exact check size in the extracted text.
The planned listing/business combination is historical intent; current listing and treasury status must be independently updated.

source_registry.capture_method: official SBI Holdings press release extract
claims_supported: SBI Ripple Asia reported a conceptual proof of concept for tokenized deposits and deposit-type digital money using existing financial infrastructure.
The model considered SBI Group's Money Tap domestic remittance service and an SBI Ripple Asia token issuance platform.
XRPL was the envisaged blockchain technology.
limitations: Proof of concept is not a production deployment or evidence of XRP token usage; tokenized deposits and deposit-type digital money are not XRP.

claims_supported: Ripple described the first live Japan ODL implementation with SBI Remit, Coins.ph and SBI VC Trade.
Ripple states XRP was used to eliminate pre-funding and reduce operating costs.
limitations: Partner press release; no independent transaction-volume data.

source_registry.publisher: TipRanks / secondary media reporting on Yoshitaka Kitao's X post
source_registry.capture_method: secondary report extract; direct X status URL was not retrievable in this run
claims_supported: Secondary media report a February 15, 2026 statement by Yoshitaka Kitao describing approximately 9% Ripple equity ownership and rejecting a $10B XRP-token holding claim.
limitations: Direct X post retrieval returned 403; secondary report is not a share register.
The reported 9% differs from the January 5 official SBI message's approximate 10%; preserve the difference rather than force a single precise percentage.

resolution.equity_exposure: SBI Holdings' official January 5, 2026 New Year's message says its investment in Ripple Labs acquired approximately 10% of Ripple shares about ten years earlier. This is corporate equity exposure, not an XRP token balance. A later February 2026 secondary report attributes an approximately 9% statement to the chairman; the direct X post could not be retrieved, and no current share register was obtained. Treat the precise current percentage as approximate and date-sensitive.
resolution.payment_rail: SBI Remit, SBI VC Trade, Ripple and Coins.ph have a documented XRP-based ODL corridor to the Philippines launched in 2021. SBI Remit is an SBI Group company; SBI VC Trade supplies exchange/liquidity infrastructure. The announcement establishes the operating design and launch, not current volumes.
resolution.stablecoin: SBI VC Trade and Ripple's Standard Custody signed an RLUSD Japan issuance/distribution agreement in 2025; SBI VC Trade began handling RLUSD in VCTRADE on 2026-06-24. RLUSD is a stablecoin product, distinct from XRP.
resolution.joint_venture: SBI Ripple Asia is a distinct 2016 company focused on blockchain/DLT FinTech. SBI Group reported 60% voting-rights ownership as of 2026-03-31; Ripple describes the company as combining SBI and Ripple expertise. The extracted SBI profile does not identify the remaining shareholder, so do not infer a precise 40% Ripple stake from this record.
resolution.tokenization: SBI Ripple Asia's February 2026 proof of concept envisaged XRPL for tokenized deposits and deposit-type digital money using Money Tap and a token issuance platform. This is an XRPL infrastructure experiment, not proof that XRP itself is the settlement asset.
resolution.evernorth: SBI Holdings announced PIPE investment in Evernorth alongside Ripple in October 2025. The release establishes participation, but not SBI's exact investment amount or current Evernorth XRP holdings.

capital_classification.direct_equity: SBI Holdings' disclosed Ripple Labs shareholding is corporate equity capital.
capital_classification.token_inventory: The official equity disclosure does not state that SBI holds an equivalent amount of XRP tokens.
capital_classification.payment_liquidity: SBI VC Trade's XRP liquidity role in ODL is an operational market-making/settlement function; it is not equivalent to SBI Holdings' corporate equity stake.
capital_classification.stablecoin_reserves: RLUSD reserve backing belongs to the RLUSD issuer/custody structure; it is not SBI's XRP capital or SBI's own reserve asset.
capital_classification.evernorth_pipe: SBI's Evernorth PIPE participation is a separate investment commitment; exact SBI amount is not stated in the cited release.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The viral '$10B XRP' claim confuses SBI's Ripple equity stake and ecosystem exposure with direct XRP token holdings.
evidence_for: Official SBI message describes approximately 10% Ripple shares.
Secondary report attributes a later chairman statement rejecting the $10B XRP-token claim.
evidence_against: No current audited SBI XRP-token custody schedule was obtained.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The 9% and 10% figures may reflect rounding, different dates, share dilution or secondary-report imprecision.
evidence_for: Official Jan 5 message says approximately 10%; Feb 16 secondary report says around 9% based on a Feb 15 social post.
evidence_against: No dated share register or direct X post capture is available.

competing_hypotheses.claim: SBI Ripple Asia's tokenized-deposit PoC may be confused with XRP token demand.
evidence_against: The stated instruments are tokenized deposits and deposit-type digital money; the release does not say XRP is the asset.

competing_hypotheses.claim: The 2021 ODL launch proves a live corridor at launch but not its current throughput or material XRP market impact.
evidence_for: Official launch releases name counterparties, asset and operating flow.
evidence_against: No current corridor volume, inventory or settlement telemetry is in the source set.

confirmed: SBI Remit/SBI VC Trade/Ripple/Coins.ph ODL launch using XRP as bridge asset.
SBI VC Trade RLUSD product launch, which is a separate stablecoin.

SBI Ripple Asia XRPL tokenized-deposit PoC, with XRP-token use not established.

SBI Holdings' current direct XRP token inventory.
